name: comp-106
blurb: Side-by-side buttons for horizontal and vertical flip operations.
description: A grouped control with two icon buttons for flip transformations. Buttons are tightly grouped with negative margins and rounded at the ends.
use_when: Providing flip/mirror operations for images or content in an editor interface.
avoid_when: When you need state management or when the action is not flip-related.
a11y: Uses aria-label on each button and aria-hidden on icons. Focus ring z-index prevents overlap.
